serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.ArmBoth.DownNormal
You: Do you want to go to Annalie?
#bot.Expression.Clear
Bot: Sure, last time we visited her was before riots, right?
You: Yes.
#bot.Expression.Sad
You: I went to help Annalie with her shop, but it might still not be open so don’t get your hopes up.
Bot: Alright.
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: If only I was there to eliminate these threats to Annalie’s property.
#bot.Expression.Clear
You: Please, don’t ever go eliminating threats. Especially on your own. Ok?
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: Alright…
